title: GSExplorer: Interactive World Generation with a Persistent 3DGS World State
abstract: arXiv:2611.01543v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Interactive world generation requires both accurate local control and stable scene consistency over long rollouts. Existing methods improve local generation through camera or geometry conditioning and extend historical context with memory mechanisms. However, long-horizon exploration remains challenging due to incomplete target-view guidance and inconsistencies accumulated during scene updates. We present \textbf{GSExplorer}, a generation--reconstruction framework built around a persistent 3D Gaussian world state. At each step, the current 3DGS scene provides multimodal rendering conditions for a video generator, while camera geometry is injected through a separate Relative Ray Encoding branch. Generated videos are then fed back to a SLAM-based reconstruction backend, where appearance and geometric consistency checks produce a shared support mask for selective scene updates and cross-chunk pose refinement. translated_title: GSExplorer：基于持久化3DGS世界状态的交互式世界生成
translated_abstract: 交互式世界生成需要在长序列生成过程中同时具备精确的局部控制能力和稳定的场景一致性。现有方法通过相机或几何条件化来改进局部生成，并通过记忆机制扩展历史上下文。然而，由于目标视角引导不完整以及场景更新过程中累积的不一致性，长时程探索仍然面临挑战。我们提出了GSExplorer，一个围绕持久化3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）世界状态构建的生成-重建框架。在每一步中，当前3DGS场景为视频生成器提供多模态渲染条件，同时通过一个独立的相对光线编码分支注入相机几何信息。生成的视频随后被反馈到基于SLAM的重建后端，其中外观和几何一致性检查生成共享支持掩码，用于选择性场景更新和跨块位姿精化。我们进一步设计了一个……
tldr: GSExplorer提出了一种以持久化3DGS世界状态为核心的生成-重建框架，通过将当前3DGS场景作为视频生成条件、再经SLAM重建进行一致性校验与选择性场景更新，实现了长时程探索中精确局部控制与场景一致性的统一。
en_tdlr: GSExplorer is a generation-reconstruction framework built on a persistent 3DGS world state that unifies accurate local control and long-horizon scene consistency by conditioning video generation on the current 3DGS scene and selectively updating it through SLAM-based reconstruction with appearance and geometric consistency checks.
